definition: A clan, tribe, or people descended from a common ancestor, as one of the groupings of humanity in the phrase nations, kindreds, tongues, and people.
To argue or discuss with others over a matter, as when people reason together or contend over a point.
To set one thing beside another as a likeness, as when asking what can be compared to something.
Of several different kinds, sorts, or places, as in divers colours, divers diseases, or divers places.
An indefinite number of persons or things, more than one or two.
